apps.name: Marketel Front Desk
apps.subtitle: Run your property from your phone.
apps.localizedDescription: Marketel Front Desk for iPhone, connected to your live property data over Wi-Fi or cellular. Version 2 adds native iOS navigation, quick property switching, and a focused Guest App workspace. Native APNs booking alerts are not included yet.

versions.localizedDescription: Restores Revenue for eligible properties and moves the compact logo, Front Desk title, property switcher, QR, and menu into a safe-area-aware native header below the iPhone status area.
Native iOS navigation, safe-area and scrolling fixes, property sign-in and switching, synced badges, and a cleaner Guest App workspace.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Front Desk uses the camera when you choose to add a property or room photo.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Front Desk uses your photo library when you choose a property or room photo.
